usedFor: Toggl Track holds tracked work, and each “New Task” there can open one in Asana.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in Toggl Track, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A task started in Toggl Track becomes an Asana task, with assignee, dates and description set.

watchOut: “New Task” in Toggl Track is polling and looks back over a recent time window, so expect a short delay.
